metadata.source: PSOC - Potentially Suspicious Electron Application CommandLine.yaml

metadata.description: Microsoft Sentinel Log Analytics workspace name

properties.displayName: PSOC - Potentially Suspicious Electron Application CommandLine
properties.description: detects suspicious command lines from electron browsers
properties.query:
//detects suspicious command lines from electron browsers
_Im_ProcessCreate
| where TargetProcessName has_any ("chrome.exe","code.exe","discord.exe","GitHubDesktop.exe","keybase.exe","msedge.exe","msedgewebview2.exe","msteams.exe","slack.exe","Teams.exe")
| where CommandLine has_any ("--browser-subprocess-path","--gpu-launcher","--renderer-cmd-prefix","--utility-cmd-prefix")
| extend
    Account = tostring(column_ifexists("ActorUsername", "")),
    AccountDomain = tostring(column_ifexists("ActorUserDomain", "")),
    Computer = tostring(column_ifexists("DvcHostname", "")),
    ProcessName = tostring(column_ifexists("TargetProcessName", "")),
    ProcessId = tostring(column_ifexists("TargetProcessId", "")),
    CommandLine = tostring(column_ifexists("CommandLine", ""))
| where isnotempty(ProcessName)
